blocks.explanation:
\(\csc x\) ka integral formula table mein nahi hai. Lekin kitab ki Example 6 mein \(\sec x\) ke liye ek trick use hui thi; wahi yahan lagayenge.
Trick: upar neeche aisi cheez se multiply karo ke numerator, denominator ka derivative ban jaye. Phir Rule 4 (\(\int \frac{f'}{f} = \ln|f|\)) seedha lag jata hai.
Yahan woh cheez \(\csc x - \cot x\) hai.
Plan: multiply aur divide karein, \(f'(x)\) pehchanein, Rule 4 lagayein, check karein.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\int \csc x\,dx\).
Maloom karna: indefinite integral.
Tareeqa: integrand ko \(\frac{f'(x)}{f(x)}\) banana, jahan \(f(x) = \csc x - \cot x\); phir Rule 4: \(\int \frac{f'(x)}{f(x)}\,dx = \ln|f(x)| + c\).

Multiply aur divide karein
\[\int \csc x\,dx = \int \dfrac{\csc x(\csc x - \cot x)}{\csc x - \cot x}\,dx\]
\[= \int \dfrac{\csc^2 x - \csc x\cot x}{\csc x - \cot x}\,dx\]
Kyun: Upar neeche ek hi (non-zero) cheez se multiply karne se value nahi badalti. Upar bracket khola to \(\csc^2 x - \csc x\cot x\) bana.

Numerator mein \(f'(x)\) pehchanein
\[f(x) = \csc x - \cot x\]
\[f'(x) = -\csc x\cot x + \csc^2 x\]
Kyun: \(\csc x\) ka derivative \(-\csc x\cot x\) hai aur \(\cot x\) ka \(-\csc^2 x\); minus minus plus ban gaya. Dekhiye, yeh bilkul numerator hai!

Rule 4 lagayein
\[\int \csc x\,dx = \ln|\csc x - \cot x| + c\]
Kyun: Integrand ab \(\frac{f'(x)}{f(x)}\) ki shakal mein hai, aur aisi fraction ka integral denominator ka \(\ln\) (modulus ke saath) hota hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{d}{dx}\ln|\csc x - \cot x| = \dfrac{\csc^2 x - \csc x\cot x}{\csc x - \cot x}\]
\[= \dfrac{\csc x(\csc x - \cot x)}{\csc x - \cot x} = \csc x \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(\ln|f|\) ka derivative \(\frac{f'}{f}\) hai; phir upar se \(\csc x\) common nikala to bracket cancel ho gaya.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key ka masla: Question 4 ka koi jawab "EXERCISE 3.1" ke neeche nahi chhapa. Yeh jawab "Exercise 3.3" ki heading ke neeche (kitab ka safha 300) doosri tarteeb mein chhape hain: Q4 (i) = 1 (i), (ii) = 1 (ii), (iii) = 1 (xii), (iv) = 1 (viii), (v) = 1 (iv), (vi) = 1 (v), (vii) = 1 (vi), (viii) = 1 (vii), (ix) = 1 (iii), (x) = 1 (ix). Values hamare jawabon se milti hain; sirf numbering aur heading ghalat hai.

blocks.explanation:
\(\cot^2 x\) ka koi seedha formula nahi, lekin \(\csc^2 x\) ka hai: \(\int \csc^2 x\,dx = -\cot x\).
Is liye identity \(1 + \cot^2 x = \csc^2 x\) se \(\cot^2 x\) ko \(\csc^2 x - 1\) likhenge. Kitab ki Example 7 mein \(\tan^2 x\) ke saath bilkul yahi kiya gaya tha.
Plan: identity lagayein, integrate karein, check karein.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\int \cot^2 x\,dx\).
Maloom karna: indefinite integral.
Tareeqa: \(\cot^2 x = \csc^2 x - 1\), phir table ka formula \(\int \csc^2 x\,dx = -\cot x + c\).

Identity lagayein
\[\int \cot^2 x\,dx = \int (\csc^2 x - 1)\,dx\]
Kyun: \(1 + \cot^2 x = \csc^2 x\) se \(\cot^2 x = \csc^2 x - 1\). Ab dono terms ka formula humare paas hai.

Integrate karein
\[= -\cot x - x + c\]
Kyun: Table se \(\int \csc^2 x\,dx = -\cot x\), aur \(\int 1\,dx = x\).
Dhyan dein: \(\csc^2 x\) ka integral \(-\cot x\) hai, \(+\cot x\) nahi; minus sign bhoolna aam ghalti hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{d}{dx}(-\cot x - x) = \csc^2 x - 1 = \cot^2 x \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(-\cot x\) ka derivative \(+\csc^2 x\) hai, aur identity se \(\csc^2 x - 1 = \cot^2 x\).

blocks.explanation:
\(\sec^4 x\) ka seedha formula nahi. Lekin \(\sec^4 x = \sec^2 x\cdot\sec^2 x\) likh sakte hain.
Ek \(\sec^2 x\) ko waise hi rakhenge, kyunke yeh \(\tan x\) ka derivative hai; doosre ko \(1 + \tan^2 x\) mein badal denge.
Phir sab kuch \(\tan x\) aur us ke derivative ki shakal mein aa jata hai, aur General Power Rule kaam kar deta hai.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\int \sec^4 x\,dx\).
Maloom karna: indefinite integral.
Tareeqa: integrand ko \((1 + \tan^2 x)\sec^2 x\) likhna, phir table aur General Power Rule (\(f(x) = \tan x\)).

Integrand ki nayi shakal
\[\sec^4 x = \sec^2 x\cdot\sec^2 x\]
\[= (1 + \tan^2 x)\sec^2 x\]
Kyun: Identity \(1 + \tan^2 x = \sec^2 x\) sirf ek \(\sec^2 x\) par lagayi; doosra \(\sec^2 x\) derivative ka kaam karega.

Integral ko torein
\[= \int \sec^2 x\,dx + \int (\tan x)^2\sec^2 x\,dx\]
Kyun: Bracket khol kar Rule 2 lagaya. Doosra integral \([f(x)]^2 f'(x)\) ki shakal ka hai, jahan \(f(x) = \tan x\) aur \(f'(x) = \sec^2 x\).

Integrate karein
\[= \tan x + \dfrac{\tan^3 x}{3} + c\]
Kyun: Table se \(\int \sec^2 x\,dx = \tan x\). General Power Rule \(n = 2\) ke saath: \(\frac{(\tan x)^3}{3}\).

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{d}{dx}\left(\tan x + \tfrac{1}{3}\tan^3 x\right)\]
\[= \sec^2 x + \tan^2 x\sec^2 x\]
\[= \sec^2 x(1 + \tan^2 x) = \sec^4 x \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(\tan^3 x\) par chain rule: \(3\tan^2 x\cdot\sec^2 x\), aur \(\frac{1}{3}\) se 3 cancel. Phir \(\sec^2 x\) common nikal kar identity dobara lagayi.

blocks.explanation:
Yahan sine aur cosine ka product hai, aur dono ke angles alag hain (\(x\) aur \(7x\)). Product ka integral seedha nahi aata.
Kitab ki Example 10 wala tareeqa: product ko sum mein badlo, formula \(\sin mx\cos nx = \frac{1}{2}[\sin(m + n)x + \sin(m - n)x]\), yahan \(m = 1\), \(n = 7\).
Phir har sine ka integral Rule 5 se aasaani se aa jata hai.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\int \sin x\cdot\cos 7x\,dx\).
Maloom karna: indefinite integral.
Tareeqa: product-to-sum formula, phir \(\int \sin kx\,dx = -\frac{\cos kx}{k}\) (Rule 5).

Product ko sum banayein
\[\sin x\cos 7x = \tfrac{1}{2}\left[\sin 8x + \sin(-6x)\right]\]
\[= \tfrac{1}{2}\left[\sin 8x - \sin 6x\right]\]
Kyun: \(m + n = 1 + 7 = 8\) aur \(m - n = 1 - 7 = -6\). Sine odd function hai: \(\sin(-\theta) = -\sin\theta\).
Dhyan dein: \(m\) hamesha sine wala angle aur \(n\) cosine wala; ulta le liya to sign ghalat ho jayega.

Integrate karein
\[= \tfrac{1}{2}\left[-\dfrac{\cos 8x}{8} + \dfrac{\cos 6x}{6}\right] + c\]
\[= \dfrac{\cos 6x}{12} - \dfrac{\cos 8x}{16} + c\]
Kyun: Rule 5: \(\int \sin kx\,dx = -\frac{\cos kx}{k}\). Is liye \(\int \sin 8x\,dx = -\frac{\cos 8x}{8}\), aur \(-\int \sin 6x\,dx = +\frac{\cos 6x}{6}\). Phir \(\frac{1}{2}\) andar multiply kiya.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{d}{dx}\left(\tfrac{\cos 6x}{12} - \tfrac{\cos 8x}{16}\right)\]
\[= -\tfrac{1}{2}\sin 6x + \tfrac{1}{2}\sin 8x\]
\[= \sin x\cos 7x \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(\cos 6x\) ka derivative \(-6\sin 6x\), aur \(\frac{6}{12} = \frac{1}{2}\); isi tarah \(\frac{8}{16} = \frac{1}{2}\). Yeh wahi sum wali shakal hai.

blocks.prompt: 4 (v) Evaluate the following: \(\int \frac{\cos^3 x - \sin^3 x}{\cos x - \sin x}\,dx\)
blocks.explanation:
Numerator dekhiye: \(\cos^3 x - \sin^3 x\), yani do cubes ka farq. Algebra ka formula yaad kijiye: \(A^3 - B^3 = (A - B)(A^2 + AB + B^2)\).
Is se numerator mein \((\cos x - \sin x)\) nikal aata hai, jo denominator se cancel ho jata hai.
Phir \(\sin^2 x + \cos^2 x = 1\) se integrand bohat simple ban jata hai.
Plan: factorise, cancel, identity, integrate, check.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\int \frac{\cos^3 x - \sin^3 x}{\cos x - \sin x}\,dx\).
Maloom karna: indefinite integral.
Tareeqa: factorise, cancel, \(\sin^2 x + \cos^2 x = 1\), phir \(\sin x\cos x\) ke liye General Power Rule.

Factorise kar ke cancel karein
\[\dfrac{\cos^3 x - \sin^3 x}{\cos x - \sin x}\]
\[= \cos^2 x + \cos x\sin x + \sin^2 x\]
\[= 1 + \sin x\cos x\]
Kyun: \(A = \cos x\), \(B = \sin x\) le kar formula lagaya; \((\cos x - \sin x)\) upar neeche cancel hua (jahan \(\cos x \ne \sin x\)). Phir \(\cos^2 x + \sin^2 x = 1\).

Integrate karein
\[\int (1 + \sin x\cos x)\,dx = x + \dfrac{\sin^2 x}{2} + c\]
Kyun: \(\sin x\cos x\) ko dekhiye: \(\cos x\) asal mein \(\sin x\) ka derivative hai. To yeh \([f(x)]^1 f'(x)\) hai, jahan \(f(x) = \sin x\); General Power Rule se \(\frac{\sin^2 x}{2}\).

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{d}{dx}\left(x + \tfrac{1}{2}\sin^2 x\right) = 1 + \sin x\cos x \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(\sin^2 x\) par chain rule: \(2\sin x\cos x\), aur \(\frac{1}{2}\) se 2 cancel. Note: agar koi \(\sin x\cos x = \frac{1}{2}\sin 2x\) likh kar \(x - \frac{1}{4}\cos 2x + c\) nikale, to woh bhi sahi hai; dono jawab sirf ek constant se mukhtalif hain.

blocks.explanation:
Numerator \(\cos 2x\) hai aur denominator \(\sin x + \cos x\). Kya in mein koi rishta hai? Haan!
\(\cos 2x = \cos^2 x - \sin^2 x\), jo do squares ka farq hai: \((\cos x - \sin x)(\cos x + \sin x)\). Is ka ek factor denominator se cancel ho jata hai.
Plan: factorise, cancel, phir table se integrate, aur check.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\int \frac{\cos 2x}{\sin x + \cos x}\,dx\).
Maloom karna: indefinite integral.
Tareeqa: \(\cos 2x = (\cos x - \sin x)(\cos x + \sin x)\), cancel, phir table.

Factorise kar ke cancel karein
\[\dfrac{\cos 2x}{\sin x + \cos x} = \dfrac{(\cos x - \sin x)(\cos x + \sin x)}{\sin x + \cos x}\]
\[= \cos x - \sin x\]
Kyun: \(\cos 2x\) ki teen shaklon mein se \(\cos^2 x - \sin^2 x\) wali chuni, kyunke yahi factorise ho kar denominator se milti hai. \(A^2 - B^2 = (A - B)(A + B)\); \(\sin x + \cos x \ne 0\) jahan, wahan cancel jaiz hai.

Integrate karein
\[\int (\cos x - \sin x)\,dx = \sin x + \cos x + c\]
Kyun: \(\int \cos x\,dx = \sin x\), aur \(\int \sin x\,dx = -\cos x\), is liye \(-\int \sin x\,dx = +\cos x\).

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{d}{dx}(\sin x + \cos x) = \cos x - \sin x \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Yeh simplified integrand hai, jo asal fraction ke barabar hai.

blocks.explanation:
Root ke andar \(1 - \cos 2x\) hai. Identity \(1 - \cos 2x = 2\sin^2 x\) se "2x" bhi khatam aur root bhi aasaan.
Lekin ek bareek baat: \(\sqrt{\sin^2 x} = |\sin x|\) hota hai, sirf \(\sin x\) nahi. Kitab ka jawab yeh maan kar hai ke \(\sin x \ge 0\).
Plan: identity lagayein, root lein, us interval par integrate karein jahan \(\sin x \ge 0\), aur check karein.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\int \sqrt{1 - \cos 2x}\,dx\).
Maloom karna: indefinite integral.
Tareeqa: \(1 - \cos 2x = 2\sin^2 x\), root lena, phir table se \(\sin x\) ka integral.

Identity lagayein
\[\sqrt{1 - \cos 2x} = \sqrt{2\sin^2 x}\]
\[= \sqrt{2}\,|\sin x|\]
Kyun: \(\cos 2x = 1 - 2\sin^2 x\) se \(1 - \cos 2x = 2\sin^2 x\). Kisi square ka square root hamesha absolute value hota hai: \(\sqrt{a^2} = |a|\).

Integrate karein (us interval par jahan \(\sin x \ge 0\), maslan \(0 \le x \le \pi\))
\[\int \sqrt{2}\sin x\,dx = -\sqrt{2}\cos x + c\]
Kyun: Wahan \(|\sin x| = \sin x\), aur \(\int \sin x\,dx = -\cos x\).
Dhyan dein: jahan \(\sin x < 0\) ho (maslan \(\pi < x < 2\pi\)), wahan integrand \(-\sqrt{2}\sin x\) hai aur jawab \(\sqrt{2}\cos x + c\) ban jata hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{d}{dx}\left(-\sqrt{2}\cos x\right) = \sqrt{2}\sin x = \sqrt{1 - \cos 2x} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(-\cos x\) ka derivative \(\sin x\) hai. Yeh barabari wahan sahi hai jahan \(\sin x \ge 0\), jo humne shuru mein maana tha.

blocks.explanation:
Denominator \(1 + \cos x\) hai; is ka seedha formula nahi. Half-angle identity yaad kijiye: \(1 + \cos x = 2\cos^2\frac{x}{2}\).
Is se integrand \(\frac{1}{2}\sec^2\frac{x}{2}\) ban jata hai, aur \(\sec^2\) ka formula table mein hai.
Angle \(\frac{x}{2}\) hai, is liye Rule 5 (\(a = \frac{1}{2}\)) lagega.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\int \frac{1}{1 + \cos x}\,dx\).
Maloom karna: indefinite integral.
Tareeqa: half-angle identity, phir \(\int \sec^2(ax)\,dx = \frac{\tan(ax)}{a}\) (Rule 5).

Half-angle identity lagayein
\[1 + \cos x = 2\cos^2\dfrac{x}{2}\]
\[\dfrac{1}{1 + \cos x} = \dfrac{1}{2}\sec^2\dfrac{x}{2}\]
Kyun: \(\cos 2\theta = 2\cos^2\theta - 1\) mein \(\theta = \frac{x}{2}\) rakha: \(\cos x = 2\cos^2\frac{x}{2} - 1\). Aur \(\frac{1}{\cos^2} = \sec^2\).

Integrate karein (Rule 5, \(a = \frac{1}{2}\))
\[\dfrac{1}{2}\int \sec^2\dfrac{x}{2}\,dx = \dfrac{1}{2}\cdot\dfrac{\tan\frac{x}{2}}{1/2} + c\]
\[= \tan\dfrac{x}{2} + c\]
Kyun: \(\int \sec^2 x\,dx = \tan x\); angle \(\frac{x}{2}\) hone ki wajah se coefficient \(\frac{1}{2}\) se divide karna pada, jo 2 se multiply ke barabar hai. Bahar wala \(\frac{1}{2}\) aur yeh 2 cancel ho gaye.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{d}{dx}\tan\dfrac{x}{2} = \dfrac{1}{2}\sec^2\dfrac{x}{2}\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{2\cos^2\frac{x}{2}} = \dfrac{1}{1 + \cos x} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Chain rule se \(\frac{1}{2}\) aaya, phir half-angle identity ulti lagayi.

blocks.explanation:
Root ke andar \(1 + \sin^2 x\) hai. Pehla sawal: is ka derivative kya hai? \(2\sin x\cos x\), jo bilkul \(\sin 2x\) hai, yani numerator!
Is liye integrand \([f(x)]^{-1/2}f'(x)\) ki shakal ka hai, aur General Power Rule seedha lagta hai.
Plan: \(f'(x)\) pehchanein, integrate karein, check karein.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\int \frac{\sin 2x}{\sqrt{1 + \sin^2 x}}\,dx\).
Maloom karna: indefinite integral.
Tareeqa: General Power Rule, \(f(x) = 1 + \sin^2 x\), \(n = -\frac{1}{2}\).

\(f'(x)\) nikalein
\[f(x) = 1 + \sin^2 x\]
\[f'(x) = 2\sin x\cos x = \sin 2x\]
Kyun: \(\sin^2 x = (\sin x)^2\) par chain rule: \(2\sin x\cdot\cos x\). Aur double angle formula se yeh \(\sin 2x\) hai.

Integrate karein
\[\int [f(x)]^{-1/2}f'(x)\,dx = \dfrac{(1 + \sin^2 x)^{1/2}}{1/2} + c\]
\[= 2\sqrt{1 + \sin^2 x} + c\]
Kyun: \(n = -\frac{1}{2}\), to \(n + 1 = \frac{1}{2}\). \(\frac{1}{2}\) se divide karna yani 2 se multiply.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{d}{dx}\,2\sqrt{1 + \sin^2 x} = \dfrac{2\sin x\cos x}{\sqrt{1 + \sin^2 x}}\]
\[= \dfrac{\sin 2x}{\sqrt{1 + \sin^2 x}} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(\sqrt{f}\) ka derivative \(\frac{f'}{2\sqrt{f}}\); bahar wala 2 aur neeche wala 2 cancel.

blocks.explanation:
Upar neeche dono mein "2x" hai. Do identities is ka ilaaj hain: \(1 - \cos 2x = 2\sin^2 x\) aur \(1 + \cos 2x = 2\cos^2 x\).
In se fraction \(\tan^2 x\) ban jati hai, aur phir kitab ki Example 7 wala tareeqa: \(\tan^2 x = \sec^2 x - 1\).
Plan: simplify, integrate, check.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\int \frac{1 - \cos 2x}{1 + \cos 2x}\,dx\).
Maloom karna: indefinite integral.
Tareeqa: double-angle identities, phir \(\tan^2 x = \sec^2 x - 1\) aur table.

Fraction simplify karein
\[\dfrac{1 - \cos 2x}{1 + \cos 2x} = \dfrac{2\sin^2 x}{2\cos^2 x}\]
\[= \tan^2 x = \sec^2 x - 1\]
Kyun: \(\cos 2x = 1 - 2\sin^2 x\) se upar \(2\sin^2 x\), aur \(\cos 2x = 2\cos^2 x - 1\) se neeche \(2\cos^2 x\). 2 cancel, \(\frac{\sin^2}{\cos^2} = \tan^2\), aur \(1 + \tan^2 x = \sec^2 x\).

Integrate karein
\[\int (\sec^2 x - 1)\,dx = \tan x - x + c\]
Kyun: Table se \(\int \sec^2 x\,dx = \tan x\), aur \(\int 1\,dx = x\).
Dhyan dein: \(\tan^2 x\) ka integral \(\frac{\tan^3 x}{3}\) nahi hai; Power Rule tabhi lagta hai jab saath mein \(\tan x\) ka derivative \(\sec^2 x\) bhi ho.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{d}{dx}(\tan x - x) = \sec^2 x - 1 = \tan^2 x \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Yeh simplified integrand ke barabar hai.
